First Thing Awful Lot Of Cough S**up CEO Desto Dubb Did After Getting Released From County Jail Was Head Straight To The UPS Store To Ship Out Orders 📦🔥

“I Ain’t Even Showered Yet.. I Went Straight To The UPS Store” 😭💪💯

Desto Dubb is a Los Angeles-based rapper, entrepreneur, and streetwear designer best known as the founder and CEO of That’s A Awful Lot Of Cough Syrup, one of the most recognizable streetwear brands to emerge from LA’s hip-hop culture. Born Joshua Taylor, Desto Dubb built his reputation by combining music, fashion, and street culture into a successful business. His clothing brand became popular for its bold designs, oversized graphics, and signature hoodies, gaining support from major rappers, celebrities, and influencers. What started as an underground clothing movement eventually grew into a nationally recognized streetwear brand.

Beyond fashion, Desto Dubb has established himself as a respected figure in the Los Angeles rap scene, building connections with artists such as Drakeo The Ruler, OhGeesy, and other influential West Coast rappers. His entrepreneurial journey has made him an inspiration to independent artists and business owners looking to turn their creativity into a successful brand. Through his music, clothing releases, celebrity collaborations, and strong presence in LA culture, Desto Dubb continues to expand his influence while representing the city’s independent hustle and streetwear movement.
